name: composemail-mime-opaque
description: SendMail carrying a MIME message. MS-ASCMD 2.2.3.109 says Mime is transferred as an opaque BLOB, so the payload is raw RFC 5322 bytes: base64ing it first produces a message whose visible body is base64 text, and the server's Latin-1 fallback swallows the mistake silently. The opaque run must begin with "From:".

wbxml.note: SaveInSentItems (0x08), empty element - no content bit, no END

wbxml.ascii:
From: a@b
To: c@d
Subject: hi

body

opaque.ascii:
From: a@b
To: c@d
Subject: hi

body
